title: Acoustic safety and SPL acceptance are not defined
description: The product requires independent acoustic/safety input and written limits/test methods before sale; no numeric SPL criterion is supplied. A numeric limit must not be invented.

evidence.note: Independent acoustic expert/lab must provide written sales-release criteria.

closure_criterion: Obtain signed or controlled expert/lab-defined acoustic safety limits, measurement setup, peak/duration and fault/instability acceptance method; demonstrate compliance and trace it into release evidence before R14 PASS.
